recommendations.title: Diagnose and fix Payntra's 502 — user-facing neighbour app is down
recommendations.reason: payntra.terrybot.top returned HTTP 502 at 06:00 SGT on the live health check. OpenReply and SYNTRA on the same VPS are responding, so the VPS and Caddy are fine — the failure is specific to Payntra's upstream. Payntra handles Chris's own monthly expense ledger (a private tool), so the blast radius is one user, but it's the kind of 'works when I last looked' drift that ages silently until the next salary-clearout morning. The fix is mechanical: identify the failed container (payntra-app vs payntra-db vs Caddy upstream marker), restart the unhealthy service, verify /api/health returns 200. ~10 minutes.
recommendations.action: Run from the host: `ssh dev-vps 'sudo -n docker compose -f /srv/projects/payntra/docker-compose.yml ps 2>&1 | head; curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://payntra.terrybot.top/api/health 2>&1'`. If payntra-app is exited/restarting: tail the last 50 lines of logs, fix the crash cause, recreate. If Caddy upstream marker is stale (502 with no logs from payntra-app): edit /srv/caddy/sites/payntra.caddy to refresh the loopback host port, validate + reload Caddy. Re-verify /api/health returns 200 before declaring closed.

non_negotiable.title: Get Payntra back to HTTP 200 on /api/health before 09:00 SGT
non_negotiable.reason: Payntra is the only one of Chris's three live apps that's currently down — OpenReply is healthy, SYNTRA is healthy, Payntra is 502. The blast radius is small (one user: Chris), but Payntra is the personal finance tool he uses to clear out bills when his salary hits, and the next salary cycle is the kind of moment where 'app is down' goes from a nuisance to a real cost. The fix is mechanical (read-only diag → identify dead container or stale upstream → restart/recreate → verify /api/health returns 200). Skipping it means Payntra silently 502s all day and the morning-brief has to mention a degraded app. 10 minutes, fully reversible, single-host. No excuses.
non_negotiable.action: From the host at session start: `ssh dev-vps 'sudo -n docker compose -f /srv/projects/payntra/docker-compose.yml ps 2>&1 | head -10; echo ---HEALTH---; curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://payntra.terrybot.top/api/health'`. If payntra-app is exited: tail last 50 lines of `docker logs payntra-app 2>&1`, identify the crash cause (DB connection? env var? unhandled promise?), fix root cause not symptom, recreate. If payntra-app is running but 502 persists: inspect /srv/caddy/sites/payntra.caddy for stale upstream port, refresh the loopback to the live container port, `sudo -n caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && sudo -n systemctl reload caddy`. Re-verify with the same curl. Print the final HTTP code and the action taken — that goes back into the brief reply.
